task_context.problem_statement:
Nell collects baseball cards. She had 573 cards. She gave 195 cards to John and yet some more to Jeff. Now she has 210 cards left.
How many cards did Nell give to Jeff?
( ( 573.0 - 195.0 ) - 210.0 )
